messages:
Rina: quick pet photo drop  Mochi (hedgehog) did a full reconnaissance of the windowsill and then derailed into a nap pile. photo: https://cdn.redwood.app/mochi/3166004321_mochi_scout.jpg
Omar: that is a very precise snooze position. like  he's conducting a stakeout.
Tess: adorable. does Mochi have a favorite stick/leaf?
Rina: he hoards one tiny leaf indefinitely. its his lucky flag.
Jules: :heart_eyes: hedgehog + windowsill = peak content. also tiny snoot.
uploader-bot: Uploaded file "mochi_snoozes.mp4"  https://cdn.redwood.app/mochi/3166004321_snoozes.mp4
Omar: watched  0:03 when he twitches = instant smile.
Tess: poll: should Mochi be allowed supervised outruns in the office circle this Friday? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Rina: :thumbsup: yes but only on a fleece track
Jules: :thumbsup: yes, bring tiny goggles
Omar: :thumbsdown: only if everyone signs a cuddle waiver. joking. mostly :thumbsup:
Tess: tagging office-safety for quick notes re: droppings and escape-proofing :)
Rina: thanks team  saving for morale and also to remind myself where i put that tiny leaf.
